title: Water under stone
briefing: The rock glows in the midday sun, and the suit's cooling is already working. Somewhere beneath the ravine lies an aquifer. We need to know how deep it is before we build anything here.
goal: Drill a sample at the aquifer and place a relay on the ravine's edge.

main_sample.label: The Aquifer Bore
main_sample.text: The drill hits moisture at forty meters. The water is there — but it has to be pumped up, and the pumps will cost power.

risk_sample.label: The Exposed Ore Vein
risk_sample.text: The ore lies right at the surface, warm to the touch even through the glove. There's enough here to build a town.

routes.label: In the shade of the ravine wall
routes.description: A detour, but the shade keeps the suit cool.

routes.label: Across the sun flat
routes.description: The direct route across the white flat. The heat drains the suit quickly.

evacuation: The suit's cooling is at its limit. ARK: “Find shade, captain, and walk slowly. The lander is waiting for you.”

findings.main: Ferrum: The water lies deep. The water plant must be built first and have enough power.
findings.risk: Ferrum: The ore lies at the surface. Building will be cheap here.
findings.relay: Ferrum: The relay on the ravine edge looks out over the whole valley.
